import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sin(p[9]*t); c=np.cos(p[9]*t)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*P+p[3]*P*np.log(P)+p[4]*P**2
            + p[5]*s*P + p[6]*c*P + p[7]*s + p[8]*c)
